instruction: Add a SUM formula in cell E37 to calculate the total of all values in the Quantity column.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent attempted to sort data by Date Time ascending and create a line chart. Successfully sorted the data but repeatedly failed at chart creation, getting stuck in the Chart Type dialog with Column chart selected for many turns before finally selecting Line near the end but running out of turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can sort spreadsheet data by column, navigate menus, open Insert > Chart dialog, select data ranges
metadata.failure_analysis: Model successfully sorted data but failed to complete chart creation. Got stuck in Chart Type dialog, repeatedly defaulting to Column type. Eventually found Line type but exhausted the 50-turn limit.
metadata.task_rationale: Tests basic cell editing and formula entry in the same spreadsheet. A simple single-step task that stays within the model's demonstrated capability of interacting with LibreOffice Calc cells.
metadata.explanation: Task requires adding a SUM formula in cell E37 to total the Quantity column. Getter reads cell E37 value (with data_only=True) and checks for formula presence (without data_only). Metric gives 0.4 for having a formula, 0.6 for correct computed value (780).

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads cell E37 from sheet 0 with both data_only=True (for computed value) and data_only=False (for formula detection)
Metric correctly handles expected parameter for type='rule' — directly accesses expected.get('expected_value', 780)
Postconfig properly saves the file (Ctrl+S) before getter reads, ensuring computed values are cached in the xlsx
Partial credit scoring is reasonable: 0.4 for formula presence, 0.6 for correct computed value
Minor gap: evaluator checks for any formula (startswith '=') but does not verify it is specifically a SUM formula — any formula producing 780 would pass
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Optionally check that the formula string contains 'SUM' (case-insensitive) to verify it is specifically a SUM formula as instructed, though this is a minor concern
